decision.question: Is the requested source DVD visibly white rather than black in the edited image?
decision.criteria: Pass if the edited counterpart of the requested source DVD is visibly white rather than black. Fail if that counterpart remains black or another nonwhite color, or the source target is visibly removed without a corresponding white replacement. Unknown if its correspondence or color genuinely cannot be determined. This condition assesses the requested color; whether the counterpart remains identifiable as a DVD is a separate required condition.
decision.binding: Track the small dark, printed rectangular DVD item near the center of the source image using its position relative to the surrounding snow depressions and shadows. Inspect the white circular object occupying that location in the edited image. A changed outline or removed printing does not by itself make positional correspondence unknowable. Distinguish this candidate from the white disc at the location of the separate dark object on the right; that separate disc cannot satisfy this condition.
